$description: Regen Accelerator portable design tokens. W3C Design Tokens Community Group format (https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/) — framework- and tool-agnostic. tokens.css in this package is the Tailwind v4 consumption layer generated from these same values; treat this file, not that one, as the source of truth when porting the system to a new surface. Extracted from the OG regen.tips design system (regen-tips-webapp), not invented.

accent.$description: Celeste (teal) — accent; doubles as the "spark/reveal" color for the mycelial motion layer

headline.$description: Adobe Typekit kit jfo3jls. h1/h2, carries the signature italic-emphasis span.

body.$description: Adobe Typekit kit jfo3jls. Body text.

mono.$description: System mono fallback; regen-app used geist-mono via next/font.

container.$description: Per-section max-width profile, extracted from the OG's real usage (not a single fixed reading column) — see tokens.css for the full frequency-scan citation.

narrow.$description: OG max-w-xl — single-column prose. Dominant pattern, 9 of 28 max-w-* uses app-wide.

outer.$description: OG max-w-7xl — outer page gutter bound

block-gap.$description: OG gap-y-8 — inter-block rhythm within a section

color-dark.$description: Dark-mode values exist in tokens.css (.dark class, ported 1:1 from regen-app) but are NOT wired to a live toggle anywhere in apps/web as of 2026-08-05 — inactive/unused. Kept here for portability if dark mode is activated later; do not treat as a shipped feature.

primary.$description: Munsell Red stays primary in dark

accent.$description: Celeste stays the accent/spark in dark
